custom_logic_notes: Fisher Transform X2 strategy uses the Fisher Transform oscillator crossing the zero line for entry signals. X2 designation indicates dual-threshold or dual-crossover logic. The EA checks for new bar formation before evaluating signals to avoid multiple entries within the same bar. SL/TP values are in points and require digit adjustment (multiply by 10) for 5-digit brokers where _Point=0.00001.
python_conversion_notes: Fisher Transform indicator must be reimplemented in Python since it is a custom indicator (iCustom). The Fisher Transform formula: calculate median price, apply smoothing over N periods, then apply the Fisher transform: y=0.5*ln((1+x)/(1-x)) where x is the normalized value. Entry signals are zero-line crossovers. New bar guard logic needed to prevent repeated signals. Digit adjustment for SL/TP: if Point<0.001, multiply SL/TP input values by 10.
